notes: Duration tiers for story.prompt_compiler gate 5 (second half).

Scope: max_shot_s is a SINGLE-GENERATION (per-shot / per-clip) cap, as declared by each source below. max_total_s would be an episode-total cap; no source below verifies one, so it is null everywhere, never invented.

A provider key absent from this table, or present with null caps, both resolve to tier verdict 'unknown' in the compiler: recorded, never used to clamp, pad or truncate. Explicit caller-supplied provider_caps always win over this table.

Sources are hevi's own verified facts only. facts.py rows are the authoritative provider catalogue (see docs/architecture/provider_authority.md); capability_guard projects from the same table. media_profiles.py platform publish limits (youtube / reels / tiktok ...) are distribution caps, not generation caps, and are deliberately NOT listed here.

fasth3_local.notes: Local FastH3 8-step ComfyUI route (video.fasth3_local). Distinct from facts.py h3_local (8.0s, older H3 runtime).

gemini_api.notes: providers.json supplier; models.json lists image-only models for this supplier. No verified video duration tier.

h3_local.notes: Older self-hosted H3 runtime; not the FastH3 8-step route (see fasth3_local).

manim.notes: Library render (no inference); cap is a declared runtime ceiling, not a model limit.

monid.notes: providers.json supplier; no verified video duration tier in hevi.

pixstag.notes: PixStag API route for MiniMax-H3 / doubao-seedance models.
